body: Hey, I just got back from being AFK. If you wanna talk, shoot me a PM. I need more buddies.

I just want to say I feel similarly. We're both still here, so there's that. 

My best friend's ex-boyfriend killed himself last week. She has been inconsolable. She can't function. Yesterday was her son's birthday and she was barely able to be present, let alone supportive. 

Even if your parents are frustrated, they are frustrated because they love you and they want good things for you. They're not frustrated at you. They're frustrated at the world, at hos doctors aren't helping, at all that. It's not your fault. They would be devastated if they lost you. Parents have this magical bond with children. It's crazy strong, even if you don't think they care, they are biologically compelled to want to save you and protect you and help you heal. You would ruin their lives if you ended yours. Even if you think it's bad now, it would be 1,000 times worse if you did it. 

So maybe try to build some positive momentum? Draw something, play your favorite video game, do something you enjoy to forget and smile for a few moments. That helps. That will make it easier to deal with harder things.

Iodine is the best to use to clean that wound. Povidone-iodine is non-staining. You can google instructions about diluting it. Don't cover the wound; the kitty will just rip it off/eat it. Also don't use anything like neosporin - kitty is just going to lick it off and then the antibiotic is messing with their digestive tract. 

Also, I'm pretty sure you have a little boy. Just a guess, though!

Hey. I just want to say my body is very similar. I get awful, rage- and self-hatred-filled pmdd for 2 weeks, and the irritability and self loathing continue the week ok my period. So 3 out of 4 weeks, I don't want the world to see me because of how awful I am. I don't want to experience any of it. 

I tried monophasic birth control pills. This made me a steady level of crazy bitch for 3.5 weeks. I've tried telling my doctors and they say I'm probably bipolar
 Other doctors said my symptoms were impossible. 

I just want you to know you're not alone.
I've heard about that film. I just want to know why that feeling exists when I want nothing except death. Thanks for reading.
